headline: Residents testify on proposed Maui property tax rates

meeting.voteItem: Item announced just before adjournment (wording unclear)
meeting.summary: The Maui County Council heard testimony on proposed property tax rates and tiers, including from bed-and-breakfast and vacation rental owners.
meeting.recap: The meeting was for public testimony on proposed property tax rates and tiers.[[0:01:05]] The council will decide the rates and tiers at the first reading of the budget.[[0:01:14]] He said he would accept the first tier rising from $2.00 to $2.25 and the second tier from $3.00 to $3.50.[[0:10:36]] A speaker for the Maui Chamber of Commerce supported the proposed rates for apartment, commercial and industrial properties.[[0:11:33]] She asked why no change was suggested for non-owner-occupied properties valued over $3 million.[[0:11:55]] She supported keeping one tax rate for agricultural land instead of tiers.[[0:13:45]] She asked the council to keep this year's rate or lower it.[[0:17:38]] A speaker for the Royal House of Hawaiʻi asked whether any of the budget will go back to Hawaiians.[[0:19:35]] It was announced that the budget is scheduled for May 15th.[[0:22:08]]
decided: The presiding officer asked for objections and, hearing none, said "so ordered" just before adjourning.
meeting.next: The council will decide the property tax rates and tiers at the first reading of the budget.
